# David McMillan Consulting

> David McMillan is an independent strategy and transformation consultant based in Greater Boston, Massachusetts. He helps senior leaders develop clear strategies, align stakeholders, and build the governance and performance systems that translate strategic priorities into coordinated action and measurable results. He spent 20 years with Palladium, the strategy execution firm, and now advises commercial, government, and mission-driven organizations through David McMillan Consulting.

## Core expertise

- Enterprise strategy
- Governance and organizational alignment
- Performance management and KPIs (including the Balanced Scorecard)
- Transformation and change management
- Portfolio and project management
- Executive facilitation and coaching
- Training and capacity building

## Background and credentials

- Worked personally with Drs. Robert Kaplan and David Norton, originators of the Balanced Scorecard; applies their Execution Premium Process methodology
- Three client engagements he led (Millipore, the FBI, and CHRISTUS Health) are in the Balanced Scorecard Hall of Fame for Executing Strategy
- Kaplan-Norton Strategy Execution Certified Graduate; Project Management Professional (PMP)
- BSc in Economics, The Wharton School, University of Pennsylvania
- Guest Lecturer, Simmons University MBA Program (Balanced Scorecard)
- 50+ strategy clients served across 6 continents; 300+ strategy leaders trained with a 98% recommendation rate

## Selected clients

Caribbean Airlines, Amtrak, the FBI, CHRISTUS Health, Millipore, Canadian Blood Services, USAID (CATALYZE), St. Lucia Electricity Services (LUCELEC), Canadian Medical Association, Ottawa Public Health, U.S. Army, Navy Medicine, John Deere, International Finance Corporation, and others.

## Publications

- [Reimagining the Balanced Scorecard for the ESG Era](https://hbr.org/2021/02/reimagining-the-balanced-scorecard-for-the-esg-era) - Harvard Business Review, 2021, co-authored with Robert S. Kaplan
- [Building Climate Resilience in the Mining Sector](https://ifcsia.org/publications/climate-resilience-mining/) - International Finance Corporation (World Bank Group), 2024
- [Masters of Strategy Execution: Balanced Scorecard Hall of Fame Report 2014](https://drive.google.com/file/d/16k1Qbc1yqqodp8B1IPSsZtXavQBDERwN/view?usp=sharing) - Palladium, 2014
